|Case |Jamfile |Built and run on |It prints

|`+block+`: The AES block cipher on ctaes: the FIPS 197 block encrypted and decrypted again.
a|

[source,bash]
----
exe block : block.cpp /webcpp/crypto//crypto /third_party//ctaes ;
----
|native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten
a|

[listing]
----
ctaes aes256 ok
----

|`+encrypt_and_sign+`: Two backends in one program: AES-256-GCM on the default backend and a BIP 340 signature.
a|

[source,bash]
----
exe app : app.cpp /webcpp/crypto//crypto /third_party//bearssl /third_party//secp256k1 ;
----
|native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten
a|

[listing]
----
aes256_gcm ok backend=bearssl
schnorr ok
----

|`+openssl_linked+`: OpenSSL, built from source, as the default backend natively and on WASI.
a|

[source,bash]
----
exe app : app.cpp /webcpp/crypto//crypto /webcpp/crypto//openssl ;
----
|native, wasip2, wasip3
a|

[listing]
----
HAS_OPENSSL=1
tag 530f8afbc74536b9a963b4f1c4cb738b
----

|`+sign+`: A BIP 340 signature with libsecp256k1's default tables.
a|

[source,bash]
----
exe sign : sign.cpp /webcpp/crypto//crypto /third_party//secp256k1 ;
----
|native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten
a|

[listing]
----
schnorr ok
----

|`+sign_small+`: The same program with libsecp256k1's small tables, smaller and slower to verify.
a|

[source,bash]
----
exe sign : sign.cpp /webcpp/crypto//crypto /third_party//secp256k1
  : <webcpp-secp256k1-tables>small ;
----
|native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten
a|

[listing]
----
schnorr ok
----
